title: Mixed Event — Beside Unchanging Warmth

meta.Outline: One day in December, Mizuki's sister sends word from abroad that she'll be coming to visit, to Mizuki's delight. Warm memories resurface, of a time long ago when the two of them went shopping together. And so, Mizuki extends an invitation to go once again.

Oh, I see what you mean.
This color does have a mature feel to it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I think you should try it on, Mafuyu.
The impression you give off may change a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, it's all yours if you want it...?
It's not all that frilly or anything, so you should be able to wear it on a regular basis!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But...
Didn't you get this for yourself?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, it came from a lucky bag!
I thought it'd look great on you the second I saw it, Mafuyu! That's why I really wanna see you with it on!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Plus, it's cute and fashionable...
It could help change the way you feel a little.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but you don't have to take it if you don't want it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll take it...
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, let's see how you look with it on♪
Ooh, want me to do your hair?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That won't be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What?! Why?!
Pretty please!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I'm so happy for you, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Kanade, Mafuyu...
I hope you and Mizuki keep getting to have fun like this!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um... Yes, I hope so as well...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sis, you're embarrassing me!
And Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Huh? I just thought I needed to say that as your big sister!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, you really didn't...
A few hours later
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? You got me a present...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but it's really nothing special...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
I mean, Shii, it's from you... I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, can I open it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, what a cute little rabbit...!
Its eyes sparkle, and it has such a fluffy tail...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This is so wonderful.
Are you really sure I can have this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Well, yeah. It's for you.
Also, it isn't just a souvenir... It's a small token of appreciation for all the support you've given me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So, thanks.
And good luck with work...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Geez, I knew this would happen!
Personal space!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you just gave me this wonderful gift and wished me good luck...! I don't know what else to do with myself!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Shii! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I promise to return the favor.
Oh, I know! You also like rabbits, so I could get you a similar accessory and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No need.
That would sort of defeat the purpose...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plus, I already got the same brooch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, you wanted us to match?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, you're getting the wrong idea.
I bought it because I also wanted one. They just happen to match.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We always used to wear matching outfits when we were little. It'll be just like back then♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, wrong idea...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know! Then, Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why don't we go somewhere together with our brooches on?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: T-Together?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, that'd be way too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please, Shii!
We're going to have an absolutely wonderful time if we go out together with our brooches! I'm sure of it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I beg you...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine, just this once...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! That's a promise, Shii♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I promise.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting this to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still... If she's this happy about it, then I'm glad I got one for myself too.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's something that I'd never buy normally, but Mizuki definitely had a point about turning it into a keychain...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I have to admit that it's really cute...
Walking around with it on might be nice.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The next time I see Mizuki and the others, I should thank them again for helping me pick these out...)
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... This effect still doesn't feel right.
The melody's pretty mellow, so I could try slowing down the transitions and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's already three in the morning...?
We walked around a ton at the mall, so I guess I should be feeling sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line: <Amia, that asset you asked for is done. Mind taking a look?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Enanan's already finished...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's exactly what I wanted...!
<Thanks! It's perfect!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Even though it's New Year's, everyone's hard at work... That means I should probably keep going for a little bit longer!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try using this asset and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line: Mizuki, are you still awake?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sis, you're still up?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, were you working on something...?
Sorry, there's something I wanted to give you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Give me...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Here you go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow, a scrunchie...!
It's so frilly and cute...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?
This looks like...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It's the same style as the one you gave Mafuyu.
I tried replicating it in a different color.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Also, if they'd like...
I made some for Kanade and Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you made some for them too?!
Wow! Ena's gonna be especially happy!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But why'd you make one for each of us...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Today, after meeting Kanade and Mafuyu, I realized just how much everyone in your group means to you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, I thought they'd serve as a nice charm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: They're my way of wishing you'll always be together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So we'll always be together...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I understand if you think it's too much...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I really appreciate the thought...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Sis...!
I'll give these to Kanade and Ena the next time I see them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You gave me the push I needed again...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Us shopping today...
It reminded me of when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You cheered me up when my classmates said all those mean things to me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What you said back then allowed me to keep liking the things I thought were cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, not just then...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, Mizuki, what do you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I'll be happy as long as you believe in what you believe, Mizuki. I always have and always will.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Don't mind what anybody else thinks, Mizuki. Your feelings come first. That's why I asked.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Also, don't you want her to get more joy from the things that she loves deep down...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Then, why don't you go over to her and give her some suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When my pain was at its worst, and even now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You've been placing how I feel at the forefront...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's probably why I still like what I like and have been enjoying things lately.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, thank you. For everything...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm glad to hear that I've been able to help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: However, Mizuki, I also need to thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Because you're the reason I decided to become a designer at all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Remember how happy you were every time I made clothes for you when you were little? That always put a big smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: That's when my hobby of designing clothes turned into a passion. I wanted you to keep feeling that way...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Before I realized it, I was doing what I could to make others smile by making clothes for them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Even now, I'm reminded of that feeling anytime you say how cute the outfits I make are.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Which is why, no matter how hard things get, I'm able to keep trying...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I know you're gonna become a great designer who makes everybody smile, Sis...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I mean, just look at me.
I've known forever that you make the best outfits in the world!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, I'll be rooting for you...
Keep doing your best, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, I will...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I'll be rooting for you as well...
I want you to keep cherishing your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I will...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm honestly still a little scared, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks, Sis.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing my best.
